The 407 is probably the most misread proxy error. It looks like the website blocked you, but the site never saw the request. The proxy stopped it, usually over a missing or wrong login.
Worth reading the Proxy-Authenticate header before touching anything else. Basic just wants user and password. NTLM or Negotiate means a corporate proxy, and that's a more annoying fix.
On HTTPS it hides as "Tunnel connection failed: 407".

Does something like AI even exist?

It’s about the democratization of #knowledge. According to his philosophy, AIs are neither a new tool nor a product that can or should be sold, but rather naturally emerging synergies that arise from connecting the knowledge of the people who use the internet.
So the problem isn’t this interconnection in and of itself, but—once again—the privatization of the commons by #thieves and #charlatans from #Silicon Valley or wherever. author: macgyverphotography.wordpress.com@macgyverphotography.wordpress.com
text:
Are Artcraft’s vibe-coded apps likely replacements for Adobe’s products?

Adobe’s decision to go with a shakedown subscripton model for its Creative Cloud apps has sparked a rush to create alternatives, particularly in the open-source community.
We’ve looked at Darktable and digiKam and Lap among free open-source alternatives to Adobe’s Lightroom Classic for both digital-asset management and RAW editing. 
But for people who already have muscle memory for Adobe’s products, these programs have a steep learning curve.
But Artcraft has apparently found a way to clone Adobe’s apps and offer them as freeware.
Artcraft has produced clones of many of Adobe’s apps, such as Lightroom, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects and Illustrator, as well as some of the Microsoft Office Suite and Avid, an audio editor, all of which can be downloaded here.Artcraft/Courtesy photo
There’s also a launcher app available that seems like its own version of the Creative Cloud desktop app to ensure you’re using the most up-to-date version of the software (without Adobe’s monthly rent payments).
The creators used the Claude AI to “vibe code” clones in what is described as a clean-room implementation process, in which the app’s functions were duplicated without using any of it’s source code. Vibe coding does programming through describing what the program should do and the AI generating the code.
The programs are written in the Rust programming language, meaning that they will run natively on Windows, Mac and Linux, the latter being something Adobe couldn’t do.
It has captured much, but not all, of the Adobe apps’ functionality, as well as created reasonable facsimilies of the interfaces. Lightcraft, the Lightroom clone, also doesn’t have the print or map modules or lens profiles.
As Andy Hutchinson and others have pointed out, it’s subject selection is not quite ready for prime time.
https://youtu.be/xOtUgbwpx78?si=IRu3WK3ZoGEn_jTU
It also lacks some of the AI features found in Lightroom, but the program is still being developed, so that could change.
I’ve taken it on a test drive, and it worked reasonably well. Was it as good as Lightroom? Not quite, but I could make satisfactory edits on photos. Since I cannot get an Adobe license for my laptop, I think it is a good option for editing photos in the field. 
Have you downloaded any of Artcraft’s apps yet? Tell me what you think in the comments.

author: agentmetry@infosec.exchange
text:
Launched today: Agentmetry, a local-first endpoint sensor for AI coding agents. Open source, Apache-2.0.
The problem: coding agents now run shell commands, read files and call MCP tools with the developer's own permissions. The transcript is a conversation, not a record, and EDR sees a process start a process, which is exactly what a working agent looks like.
How it works:
- Hooks at the tool boundary of Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, Qwen, Kimi, Qoder and CodeBuddy. Stdio MCP servers go through an audit proxy.
- Every tool call lands in a hash-chained JSONL trail on your machine. Edit one record and agentmetry verify fails. agentmetry anchor publishes a checkpoint the host cannot rewrite.
- Arguments are hashed inside the hook by default. DLP matches record the rule id, never the secret.
- Sequence detections, not single-event alerts: a credential read followed by network egress is one finding. Labelled with MITRE ATT&CK, and ATLAS where it adds something.
- MCP rug-pull detection: tools/list is fingerprinted per tool, so a listing that moves while the config stays the same is flagged (ATLAS AML.T0109).
- Forwards to Splunk, Elastic, Google SecOps or Microsoft Sentinel. No telemetry, nothing leaves until you configure a sink.
What it does not do:
- It only sees agents whose hooks are installed. A browser chat or an IDE with hooks off is invisible.
- It records what a shell call launched, not what that process did inside. That is your EDR's job.
- Windows and Linux are tested in CI. macOS is in preview.
- Public alpha, one maintainer.
The detection benchmark ships in the package: 57 cases, 0 missed, 0 false positives. Rerun it with agentmetry benchmark rather than trusting me.
Try it with nothing installed: uvx agentmetry demo
It replays a credential theft into a temp folder, raises the finding, then shows the trail failing verification after one edit.
Criticism very welcome, especially from anyone doing detection engineering or rolling agents out to a team.

text:
Die aktuelle Version 1.0.1 der nationalen IT-Architekturrichtlinie der Bundesrepublik Deutschland [1] beinhaltet mit der allgemeinen Vorgabe "AV-07 Open Source" die folgende Aussage:

[...] Open Source soll als Grundprinzip priorisiert werden. [...]

Gefolgt von drei Regeln zum Einsatz von Open Source Software. Jede dieser Regeln beinhaltet, genau wie die oben angeführte Grundaussage, ein fettgedrucktes "soll".

Dieses fettgedruckte "soll" hat mich stutzig gemacht und ich habe mich auf die Suche nach seiner genauen Bedeutung in diesem Kontext begeben. Immerhin ist es extra hervorgehoben, da kann man schon mal nachschauen. 😄 Dankenswerterweise beinhaltet die IT-Architekturrichtlinie im Anhang den Punkt "Verbindlichkeit der Architekturvorgaben" [2] und dort steht:

[...] Soll: kennzeichnet eine verbindliche Aussage, von der bei Vorliegen wesentlicher Gründe abgewichen werden kann. [...] Beschreibung einer Vorgabe, von der u. a. dann abgewichen werden kann, wenn die fachliche Aufgabenerfüllung der Ressorts beeinträchtigt wäre. [...]

Für mich sagt diese Klassifizierung aus, dass "Ohne Outlook kann ich nicht arbeiten!“ für die Abkehr von Open Source Software ausreichend ist. 🤷

[1] https://nationale-it-architekturrichtlinie.gov.de

«Алиса, включи буквально любой фильм»: как я научил колонку запускать кино и сериалы на проекторе без пультов и подписок
У меня китайский проектор на Android TV. Картинку он выдает отличную, но пульт к нему самый обычный: без микрофона. Каждый раз вбивать стрелочками по буквам в экранную клавиатуру название фильма меня достало где‑то на второй день. Вправо, вправо, вниз, буква «О», влево, «К»... Опечатался: стирай половину слова и набирай заново. Приложения с каталогами вроде Lampa отличные, когда ты сам не знаешь, что глянуть, и хочешь полистать постеры под еду. Но когда ты уже точно знаешь, что хочешь посмотреть условную четвертую серию второго сезона «Пацанов» в Кубике, тыкать пультом по меню пять минут откровенно в лом. В той же комнате стоит Яндекс Станция, а рядом пристроился тихий мини‑ПК. text:
Как узнать, сколько сообщений в чате Telegram. Проверил способы из интернета на своих чатах
Стало интересно, сколько сообщений мы с женой написали друг другу за всё время. Оказалось, что в Telegram нет счётчика сообщений. Совсем: ни в профиле собеседника, ни в настройках, ни в поиске. Статистика есть у каналов, но она про охваты и подписчиков, а не про переписку с женой. Странно, правда? Приложение хранит каждое сообщение и при этом не может сказать, сколько их. Я полез искать способы и нашёл три, которые советуют чаще всего. Введи в поиск точку. Посмотри номер последнего сообщения. Выгрузи чат и посчитай. Ни один из них не выглядит сложным, поэтому я решил не верить на слово и проверить на своих чатах: шесть личных и две группы, 192 тысячи сообщений за семь лет. Потом добавил четвёртый способ, через API. Про итог скажу сразу, чтобы не томить: точно считает один способ, и это не тот, что обычно все советуют. Ещё один считает почти точно, если вычесть лишнее.

Quarterly contributor outreach

Hi Django community, thank you all for continuing to contribute to Django.

The Steering Council is reaching out to bring people's attention to a few areas. We have major features we'd like to test and review for 6.2, smaller changes that could use attention and then various New Feature ideas we'd like community input on.

Major features

These PRs are things we'd like to refine, test and get merged in. We're looking for people to test the features themselves and review the PRs. Please see our guidelines on reviewing PRs. 

CompositeField (multi-column subqueries) 
Only needs testing, not review.  
DEFAULT_PK_FIELD setting (e.g. UUID primary keys) 
Move models between apps

Sage Abdullah has a great Django London talk on how to test your project against Django's main branch. Please note that you would need to change the branch to point to the PR’s specific branch.

Other features

These are other PRs that we thought would be cool to have included in 6.2. They are in various states of refinement. We're looking for people to test and review the PRs. They are smaller in nature, so it may be easier to get involved here.

Adding QuerySet.executed_queries 
Partitioned cookies 
Support for the HTTP QUERY method 
Improve CSRF debug messaging behind proxies

New Features

This section is bringing attention to the New Features queue. Ideas are in various stages and require different types of input. With over 150 ideas so far, we'll try to provide direction for those who have limited time to participate.

Ideas needing technical vetting [medium+ effort]

These are ideas the community would like integrated, but we need contributor opinion on. The links are to proposals that could use vetting.

Ability to customize model Meta and migration generation 
Implement modern CSRF protection 
Add timeout API for tasks 
Subresource integrity (SRI) 
Adding import maps to Django

Ideas needing community input [low effort]

We encourage people to review the entire New Feature queue and use the emoji reactions. Please use the 😕 emoji to register a "saw this, but have no opinion". This helps us understand what has been reviewed by the community. We have selected a few from the list that we'd like people to weigh in on:

Better hooks to customize PasswordResetForm email sending 
Add PR help in Working with Git GitHub contribution documentation 
Service URL parsing in core (e.g. database and cache URLs) 
Standardise Task execution order 
Update AuthenticationMiddleware to delegate to Authentication Backends 
Support sending to Unicode email addresses via SMTP

Thank you

Django is built by the community and every bit helps move Django forward. We encourage everyone to feel empowered to participate. If you aren't sure where to start or have questions, ask on the Django Forum or in the Django Discord. We're happy to help you find your way in.

Python Tip #292 (of 365):
Keep "try" blocks small with an "else" clause.
try:
    count = int(text)
except ValueError:
    print("That's not a number")
else:
    print(f"Counting to {count}")
The "else" block runs only if the "try" block finished without raising an exception.
Why not put that print call at the bottom of the "try" block instead?
try:
    count = int(text)

except ValueError:
